title: “Christ is et!” — a Coca-Cola style slogan with the Hebrew word et
summary: A parody of the Coca-Cola 'Coke is it!' slogan: red Coca-Cola-style script reads 'Christ is et!', with the red Coke wave band below on the left and the Hebrew word את (et; alef in blue, tav in red) at the lower right.

words.gloss: alef-tav; the Hebrew word et, shown with a blue alef and a red tav

pictures.description: Parody of the Coca-Cola advertising logo: large red script lettering in the Coca-Cola style spells 'Christ is et!'; underneath on the left is the red Coke band with a white wave swoosh, and on the right the Hebrew word את in blue and red.

uncertain: The slide gives no explanation; the pun on 'Coke is it!' and the link between Christ and את is implied but not stated on the slide
